      @rpc_server = RPC::Server.new(@rpc_endpoint, $log)
      @rpc_server.install_supervisor_handlers(self, enable_get_dump: @enable_get_dump)
      @rpc_server.start
    end

      Fluent::RPC::Server.public_send(:sv_stop_rpc_server, self)
    end

      @counter = Fluent::Counter::Server.new(
        counter_conf.scope,
        {host: counter_conf.bind, port: counter_conf.port, log: $log, path: counter_conf.backup_path}
      )
      @counter.start

        @monitors.each do |m|
          m.send_command(graceful ? "GRACEFUL_RESTART\n" : "IMMEDIATE_RESTART\n")
        end
      end

      def reload
        @monitors.each do |m|
          m.send_command("RELOAD\n")
        end
      end

      @counter.start

          details[:docs] = octets[0] == 24 || octets[0] == 23

        when :ipv6
          details[:unspecified] = address[:wildcard]
          details[:multicast] = address[:multicast]
          details[:teredo] = address[:normalized].to_s.downcase.start_with?("2001:0:") || address[:normalized].to_s.downcase.start_with?("2001::")

        listen = target[:listen]

      def self.ipv6_purpose_for(text)
        return :unspecified if text == "::" || text == "0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0"
        return :loopback if text == "::1" || text == "0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1"
        prefixes = {
          "::ffff:" => :ipv4_mapped,
          "64:ff9b:" => :nat64,
          "100::" => :discard,
          "2001:0:" => :teredo,
          "2001::" => :teredo,
          "2001:2:" => :benchmark,
          "2001:3:" => :amt,
          "2001:20:" => :orchid,
          "2001:db8:" => :documentation,
          "2002:" => :sixtofour,
          "fe80:" => :link_local,
        }
        prefixes.each do |prefix, label|
          return label if text.start_with?(prefix)
        end
        return :unique_local if text.start_with?("fc") || text.start_with?("fd")
        return :multicast if text.start_with?("ff")
        :global
      end

        has_zone = pattern.include?("%z") || pattern.include?("%Z")
        has_msec = pattern.include?("%L") || pattern.include?("%N")
        iso = pattern == "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z" || pattern == "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%:z"
        { format: kind, time_format: pattern, zone: has_zone, msec: has_msec, iso8601: iso, json: kind == :json }

        when "ENETUNREACH", "Errno::ENETUNREACH"

        when "EAFNOSUPPORT", "Errno::EAFNOSUPPORT"

        when "EPROTONOSUPPORT", "Errno::EPROTONOSUPPORT"

        end

        info[:message] = error.to_s

      def self.fluent_log_event_profile(level, process_type, worker_id, message, attrs)
        coerced = coerce_log_level(level)
        tag = "fluent.#{log_level_name(coerced)}"
        record = { "message" => message.to_s }
        if attrs.is_a?(Hash)
          attrs.each do |key, value|
            record[key.to_s] = value
          end
        end
        worker = case process_type
                 when :supervisor then { supervisor: true, worker0: false, workers: false }
                 when :worker0 then { supervisor: false, worker0: true, workers: false }
                 when :workers then { supervisor: false, worker0: false, workers: true }
                 else
                   { supervisor: true, worker0: true, workers: false }
                 end
        record["worker_id"] = worker_id unless worker_id.nil? || process_type == :supervisor
        {
          tag: tag,
          level: coerced,
          process: worker,
          record: record,
          emit: !message.to_s.empty?,
        }
      end

      def self.build_webrick_config(bind, port, tls)
        profile = describe_webrick_profile(bind, port)
        options = {
          BindAddress: profile[:bind],
          Port: profile[:port],
          DoNotReverseLookup: true,
          AccessLog: [],
        }
        if tls
          options[:SSLEnable] = true
          options[:SSLStartImmediately] = true
          options[:SSLCertName] = [["CN", "fluentd-rpc"]]
        else
          options[:SSLEnable] = false
        end
        options[:ServerType] = nil
        options[:LoggerLevel] = :fatal
        options[:profile] = profile
        options[:cipher] = tls_cipher_profile("ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256") if tls
        options
      end

      def self.build_json_rpc_envelope(ok, payload, error)
        envelope = { "ok" => !!ok }
        if ok
          if payload.nil?
            envelope["result"] = {}
          elsif payload.is_a?(Hash)
            payload.each { |key, value| envelope[key.to_s] = value }
          else
            envelope["result"] = payload
          end
        else
          envelope["error"] = error.nil? ? "unknown" : error.to_s
        end
        envelope["jsonrpc"] = "2.0" if payload.is_a?(Hash) && payload.key?("jsonrpc")
        safe_json_dump(envelope)
      end

      def self.protocol_capability_matrix(proto)
        kind = describe_wire_protocol(proto)[:kind]
        {
          kind: kind,
          connection: kind == :tcp || kind == :tls || kind == :unix,
          datagram: kind == :udp,
          tls: kind == :tls,
          unix: kind == :unix,
          backlog: kind == :tcp || kind == :tls || kind == :unix,
          linger: kind == :tcp || kind == :tls,
          keepalive: kind == :tcp || kind == :tls,
          max_bytes: kind == :udp,
          flags: kind == :udp,
          shared_socket: kind != :unix,

      end
